name: Nakul Iyer
headline: AI-enabled product leader who builds what he specs.
intro: For seven years I've led large-scale digital delivery — loyalty platforms, data transformations, consent, and healthcare workforce systems — from discovery to launch. As AI reshaped how software gets made, I became a builder too: I prototype, design and ship my own products, and help clients rewire their delivery lifecycle around AI.

pillars.title: Product leadership
pillars.body: Discovery, prioritization and agile delivery across design, security, engineering, testing and strategy — turning what clients want into what they can ship.

pillars.title: AI-enabled delivery
pillars.body: AI SDLC transformation: choosing the tools and processes that let teams adopt AI safely and measurably.

pillars.title: Builder
pillars.body: Prototypes, designs and production apps — web, iOS and games — built with AI and understood down to the stack.
